Owen Winters
owen.winters738@example.com | Austin, TX
Owen Winters has 14 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Palodex Labs (2025-2026), where
they applied distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 193K
concurrent users. Before that, Staff Backend Engineer at Ashgrove Solutions
(2023-2025). Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Lattice Labs (2012-2023).
Education: Ph.D. Computer Engineering, University of Wisconsin-Madison, 2012;
B.S. Computer Engineering, Cal Poly, 2006. Core skills: Distributed systems,
REST API design, PostgreSQL, AWS, Node.js, Kafka.
